info.name: Subscribe to Events Via Server-Sent Events (SSE)

params.name: from
params.description: Opaque token representing position in the stream. If not provided, stream will start from the latest events.

params.name: from_timestamp
params.description: RFC-3339 timestamp indicating where to start streaming events from. This should only be used on the initial query when a cursor may not be available. Subsequent requests should use the cursor (from) as it will be more accurate.

params.name: event_type
params.description: Event type(s) to listen for. Specify multiple times for multiple types (e.g., ?event_type=user.created&event_type=user.updated). If not provided, all event types will be streamed.
